shortDescription: A modern overhaul of RimWorld's dev tools: a debug log that traces errors to the culprit mod and explains them (stack + log-prefix + Harmony patch-owner attribution, shipped library, mod-shipped + opt-in community bug DBs with an offline snapshot, About.xml incompat + proactive dependency/load-order scan, and a plain-language glossary), an in-game bug/fix report composer, a 3-tab dev actions window and reskinned palette (with nested breadcrumb paths), plus impact scoring and updated-mod tracking.
body:
## Modern Dev Tools

A modern overhaul of RimWorld's developer tools (Modern Suite). Namespace `ModernDevTools`, assembly `ModernDevTools.dll`, packageId `astryl.ModernDevTools`. C# + Harmony. Open source (MIT).

### Shared UI (`Palette`)
Dark suite chrome, no `GameFont.Tiny`, sentence case, ASCII, cached Theme.Accent, flat gray scrollbars. Shipped icons in `Textures/UI/DevTools/` via `MdtTex`. `Palette.SearchField` = suite-styled single-line text/search field; used by both the modern log search and the dev-actions search.

### Tool 1: modern debug log (`Window_ModernLog`)
Redirects `UIRoot.CheckOpenLogWindow` + `DebugWindowsOpener.ToggleLogWindow`. Left list (culled) + right inspector. Inspector: impact banner (`ImpactAssessor`) → likely source (ranked culprits) → "What this means" (diagnoses, sorted by Score) → module `DrawSection` hooks (glossary) → report card → stack trace.
- **Auto-open suppression toggle (settings, off by default): `dontAutoOpenAtMainMenu`.** When on, `Patch_CheckOpenLogWindow` suppresses the log's auto-open while `Current.ProgramState == ProgramState.Entry` (main menu / loading) and consumes `EditWindow_Log.wantsToOpen` so it doesn't linger into the game. Still auto-opens in-game; manual open always works.

### Analysis modules ("What this means") + extensibility
`ErrorModuleDef`/`ErrorModule`/`ModernDevToolsAPI` + `ErrorContext`. Pipeline: per module, `ContributeAttribution` then `Diagnose`, in `def.order`; diagnoses displayed sorted by `Score` desc. Modules: `Module_StackTrace`, `Module_LogPrefix`, `Module_MessageMentions`, **`Module_HarmonyPatches`**, `Module_VersionMismatch`, `Module_KnownIssues` (~32-entry shipped library), `Module_ModIssues`, `Module_Community`, `Module_CommunityBugs`, `Module_AboutIncompat`, **`Module_DependencyCheck`**, **`Module_Glossary`**.

**Index prewarm (startup, bg thread).** `Bootstrap` kicks `InstalledModIndex.Prewarm()` off-thread. The Harmony index is NOT prewarmed (built lazily on first analysis, after other mods' static-ctor patching completes).

**Harmony patch-owner attribution (`HarmonyIndex` + `Module_HarmonyPatches`, order 26).** Reverse-maps `"Type.FullName:Method" → owner-id[]` from `Harmony.GetAllPatchedMethods()`+`GetPatchInfo(m).Owners`, built lazily. `FrameParser.TypeMethodOf` splits frames; owners resolved via `InstalledModIndex.MatchOwnerId` (packageId → normalized → unique suffix). Attributed at `WeightHarmonyPatch`(=4). Diagnosis only when ≥2 foreign patchers or a Harmony-routed trace. Self owner excluded.

**Proactive dependency & load-order scan (`ModDependencyIndex` + `Module_DependencyCheck`, order 60).** Reads every active mod's `<modDependencies>` (`ModDependency.IsSatisfied`) + `LoadBefore/After`/`ForceLoad*`, mirroring vanilla `ModsConfig.GetModWarnings`/`FindConflicts` (reuses keys `ModMustLoadBefore/After`). Specific culprit card + a summary for "missing def/type/reference" errors. Runs late so it sees all attribution.

**Plain-language glossary (`Glossary` + `Module_Glossary`, `DrawSection`, order 900).** Scans the error + diagnoses for jargon (Harmony, transpiler, def, cross-reference, xpath, patch operation, stack trace, null reference, TPS, FPS, load order, packageId, HugsLib, type-load) and draws a "Terms in this error" card (cap 6). Uses the window's existing module DrawSection loop.

**Diagnosis source layering:** mod-shipped `About/known-issues.json` → community bug DB → shipped library → About.xml incompats. Shared `CommunityData.ParseIssues`/`Match`.

### Community data (opt-in, `CommunityData`)
Off by default; background fetch, cached, offline fallback. Sources: RimSort Community Rules, Use This Instead, and our own **known-issues.json** at `Astryls/ModernDevTools-KnownIssues` (PUBLIC, live, **14 curated engine-level signatures**). **Offline snapshot:** same corpus ships gzipped at `Data/community-bugs.json.gz` (~3.5 KB); `LoadBundledBugsIfNeeded()` loads it as the `_bugs` floor when community data is enabled but no fetch cache exists.

### In-game reporting (`ReportBuilder`, `Dialog_Report`)
Server-less composer; destination hierarchy: culprit mod's GitHub → its Workshop page → community Issue Form repo. Signature = FNV-1a → `[#xxxxxxxx]`.

### Tool 2: dev actions window (`Window_ModernDevActions`, 3-tab)
Reuses vanilla `DebugActionNode` graph. `DebugActions_Testing` adds category "Modern Dev Tools" (top) with test-log/exception actions incl. a **"Log error with jargon (glossary demo)"** action. Spawn pickers = searchable icon grid; every mod call hardened (`DebugTree`). Palette-pin path `Actions\<label>`.
- **Esc handling:** `OnCancelKeyPressed` steps up one level inside a submenu, and **closes the window at the top level**.
- **Hides the dev palette while open.** The palette is `WindowLayer.Super` and would draw over this `Dialog`-layer window; `PreOpen` removes the palette (setting `palette.suppressClosePref = true` first so `PostClose` does NOT flip the `devPalette` pref off), and `PostClose` re-adds a fresh palette when `DebugSettings.devPalette` is still on. So opening the dev actions menu hides the palette and closing it (or running a pinned/leaf action, which calls `Close()`) brings the palette back at its saved position.
- **Whole-tab search (`SearchResults`)** breadth-first (depth cap 6, guard 200000, cap 400), themed `Palette.SearchField`. **Two hang fixes (2026-07-25):** (1) the search auto-focus is deferred one frame past open (`_openedFrame`/`Time.frameCount`) so the `/` dev hotkey that opens the window can't leak into the freshly focused search box — that leak made it search `"/"`, forcing a full-tree walk of ~50k spawn-grid nodes = a ~71 s main-thread freeze; (2) the BFS is time-boxed (~300 ms budget, checked before each category build) + 20k built-node cap, so no query can ever freeze the game (partial results instead).

### Tool 3: dev palette (`Window_ModernDevPalette`)
Reskins `Dialog_DevPalette`. Small floating list of pinned actions; click to run (checkboxes toggle), thumbtack to unpin.
- **Nested breadcrumb paths.** Each pinned node's `DebugActionNode.Path` (backslash-separated) is split via `NestPrefix`: entries nested under a submenu render as a **two-line row** — a dim parent breadcrumb (`Do incident / Threats`, backslashes rendered as ` / `) above the bright leaf label. Flat top-level actions stay a single 26px line. Rows are variable-height (`RowH`=26 flat, `RowH2`=42 nested); `SetInitialSizeAndPosition` sums per-row heights so the window auto-fits, and every pin toggle recomputes it.

### Updated-mod tracking + update notes
`GameComponent_ModSnapshot` → indicator → `Dialog_ModChanges`. `Dialog_UpdateNotes` once per Version.

### Experimental hardening (two toggles, off by default)
`WindowWatchdog` + `UiHardening`.

### Testing / environment note
Silent crashes during testing traced to **ReShade** (`dxgi.dll`) on focus changes, NOT the mod.

### Localization
`Languages/English/Keyed/ModernDevTools.xml` (`MDT_*`). Recent keys: `MDT_ReasonHarmonyPatch`, `MDT_HarmonyConflict*`/`MDT_HarmonyPatched*`, `MDT_DepMissing*`/`MDT_DepInactive`/`MDT_DepOrder*`/`MDT_DepSummary*`/`MDT_DepLine`, `MDT_SectionTerms`, `MDT_Gl*` glossary, `MDT_NoMainMenuLog`(+Desc).

## GitHub Backup
Open source (MIT). Mod repo: **https://github.com/Astryls/ModernDevTools** (PUBLIC). Community bug DB (CC0): **https://github.com/Astryls/ModernDevTools-KnownIssues** (PUBLIC, `main:/known-issues.json` fetch target). `origin` on Astryls; `Source/`, `Assemblies/*.dll`, `.modmixer/`, `Data/community-bugs.json.gz` tracked; `Source/**/{bin,obj}` ignored.
